requests.description: Fix asynchronous title responses for the Browser subagent boundary case.
requests.syntheticReason: Titles do not belong to runtime scope boundaries; they only need to be isolated from parent/child requests.

requests.description: The main Agent initializes the Browser runtime, opens its own Tab, and writes parent-before.
requests.syntheticReason: The main Agent's Tab must be created using a real shared Node REPL and IAB guest, so the child can list it and it can be reverified after the child ends.

requests.description: After receiving initialization results, the main Agent launches a foreground general-purpose child.
requests.syntheticReason: Reliably generate runtime_scope=subagent requests in the shared Node REPL kernel.

requests.description: Child sees the existing Tab in the conversation, opens a new Tab, and completes a form fill.
requests.syntheticReason: Verify that real MCP calls with runtime_scope=subagent associate tabs with the current conversation: it can list the main Agent's Tab, and newly opened tabs also belong to the same conversation.

requests.description: Child 消费 Browser 检查结果并完成。
requests.syntheticReason: Child does not close tabs upon completion, allowing the parent Agent to reverify that both tabs are present after receiving the Agent tool_result.

requests.description: After receiving child results, the main Agent reuses the original Tab and confirms that the tab opened by child is still in the conversation.
requests.syntheticReason: Prove that the child did not modify the main Agent's Tab, and tabs opened by the child are preserved in the current conversation after the subagent terminates.

requests.description: The main Agent consumes reuse results and completes normally.
requests.syntheticReason: Form a normal turn complete for E2E to reverify the same guest at the final boundary.
